- Market: India commercial / enterprise offices, multi-city rollouts

## Crawl policy

- Public marketing pages are indexable.
- Disallow private shells: /admin/, /api/, /dashboard/, /portal/, /ooplanner/, /oostudio/, /access/
- Full rules: https://oando.co.in/robots.txt
- Sitemap: https://oando.co.in/sitemap.xml
